title: The collaborative platform for AI-accelerated ideation and interactive 3D | Vectary

Introducing **Vectary Canvas**, a new space for AI-accelerated ideation. → [Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/canvas/)

![](https://www.vectary.com/web-assets/media/homepage-landing-bg.jpg)

# From AI-accelerated ideation to 3D anyone can explore

Vectary is an online design platform for developing concepts with AI and creating interactive 3D presentations and AR experiences that are easy to understand and share.

No downloads. No-code. All in the browser.

[Create account](https://www.vectary.com/signup/?next=/dashboard/) [Let's talk](https://www.vectary.com/business-contact/)

Vectary Canvas Beta

## Meet your new design workflow

Research, concepting, and validation in one collaborative AI-driven environment, where 2D, 3D, and AR come together to help early ideas evolve into validated concepts faster.

[Learn more about Canvas](https://www.vectary.com/canvas/)

#### AI-accelerated concepting

Generate and evaluate ideas at speed with AI. Choose from hundreds of ready-made presets built to streamline the design process and use them with 3D models, reference images, and other inputs to get results faster.

#### 2D, 3D & AR in one environment

Work across dimensions in one connected space. Move freely between information, visuals, 3D models, and AR without breaking your flow.

#### Your collaborative canvas

A visual board for research, ideation, and validation in one continuous environment. Collect, map, and connect your content, work together in real time, and move from first idea to proven concept without switching tools or losing context.

Vectary Studio

## Some things are better explored than explained

Show how your designs work through **interactive 3D presentations or Augmented Reality experiences**.

[Learn more about Studio](https://www.vectary.com/studio-3d/)

#### Bring in your assets

Import your existing 2D and 3D files in a wide range of formats, including GLTF, GLB, OBJ, STL, FBX, DAE, STEP, and IGES, or open a model generated in Canvas. Once imported, you can continue working with your models, and anyone can easily access and view them when shared.

#### Real-time rendering

Photorealistic, real-time rendering that works on any device. Fine-tune your scene with lighting, environments, cameras, reflections, and shadows while seeing every change as you make it. Get professional-quality visuals instantly, right in your browser.

#### Advanced materials and post-processing

Turn imported and AI-generated models into production-ready interactive 3D experiences. Create realistic surfaces with refraction, absorption, subsurface scattering, clearcoat, and thinfilm. Then refine and optimize the complete scene for smooth browser-based viewing on any device.

#### Animations, interactions & configurators

Build interactive 3D experiences with smooth transitions, trigger-based interactions, and 3D configurators for real-time customization, all with no code required.

#### Embedding and sharing

Move seamlessly from creation to presentation. Share interactive 3D experiences with selected users or wider audiences through a single link for feedback, collaboration, approval, or public showcasing. Embed them on websites or other platforms so people can explore your 3D content directly.

#### App-free augmented reality

Take your designs into the real world with Web AR. Place them in any physical space directly from a smartphone or AR glasses. No app, no installation, just a link.

#### Trusted by companies worldwide to bring teams, ideas, and 3D design into one effective workflow.

Vectary Workspaces

## Bring others into your design workflow to get more from every project

Keep projects organized in one shared environment, from research and early ideas to resources, models and final experiences, so everyone can stay aligned, help shape the direction and build on existing work.

#### Centralized asset management

Organize projects, models, and materials in shared workspaces and libraries. Give teams a consistent place to find design assets and build on existing work.

#### Publishing and distribution

Make engaging 3D experiences available to wider audiences. Embed product configurators on websites, share interactive manuals, or let your products be explored across different channels.

#### Enterprise-ready

Make 3D accessible across your organization with SSO, role-based access, dedicated cloud infrastructure, API connectivity, and independently verified security controls.
